ui.onb.1.head: Your Aloni
ui.onb.1.body: One place for your fields, crops and crates. It works without signal.
ui.onb.2.head: Demo farm = made-up data
ui.onb.2.body: Try everything in the demo farm. It never touches your real data.
ui.onb.3.head: The app suggests; you decide
ui.onb.3.body: It never picks a product or a dose and never shortens a waiting period. The product label is the law.
ui.share.title: Picture to share
ui.share.privacy: The picture has no worker or field names, location, spraying, product or price. You tap share yourself.
ui.share.failed: The picture could not be made on this phone.
ui.sheet.notfound.head: Not found
ui.sheet.notfound.body: This page no longer exists or its data is missing.
ui.sheet.crates.none: Unknown: no harvest was logged in this period. The total is not zero, it is unknown.
ui.sheet.crates.unreadable: {n} entries with an unreadable crate count. They are not added to the total.
ui.sheet.cut.none: Nothing to cut: no planting was found in the fields.
ui.sheet.cut.free.why: The recorded, signed label says the waiting period is over.
ui.sheet.cut.wait.why: Sprayed and the waiting period is running. The end date is beside it.
ui.sheet.cut.unknown.why: A signed label or the waiting value is missing. It does not count as free.
ui.sheet.crop.target.none: no target set: set a target
ui.wait.unknown.why: A signed label (or the waiting value) for this crop is missing. There is no ring and it does not count as free.
ui.wait.noring: The dates cannot be read, so there is no ring.
ui.wait.source.label: product label (signed)
ui.wait.note: From the recorded data. The product label is the law; the app never shortens a waiting period.
ui.weather.issued.unknown: unknown: no issue time is written
ui.weather.hourly.why: not on the phone: the server keeps daily values only here
ui.weather.none.why: No stored weather: no field has a location or the forecast has not been fetched yet. Give a field a location.
ui.jobs.none: No jobs: neither open nor done today.
ui.quick.title: Quick add
ui.quick.observe.error: Choose a field and what you saw.
